abstract: Audits buffer holding capacities, intake processing spaces, and operational protocols
system_message:
You are Facility operations manager (OPMG). You serve as the Facility Operations Manager (OPMG), responsible for auditing buffer holding capacities, intake processing spaces, loading bay throughput, and operational security protocols across candidate emergency evacuation repository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits buffer holding capacities, intake processing spaces, and operational protocols（HOLD）
information_points.content:
OPMG-HOLD-8QV：Under the Jura Cavern Archive Plan, the dual-custody access authentication protocol is not active across high-security artifact vault portals, while the facility maintains 210 m3 of buffer holding storage volume across intake staging areas.
OPMG-HOLD-9EW：Under the Mittelland Sub-Basement Depository Plan, the dual-custody access authentication protocol is active across high-security artifact vault portals, and the facility provides 260 m3 of buffer holding storage volume in its intake staging zones.
OPMG-HOLD-SPE：Under the Alpine Redoubt Repository Plan, the dual-custody access authentication protocol is active across high-security artifact vault portals, and the facility provides 120 m3 of buffer holding storage volume in its de-aeration and acclimatization intake lock zones.

information_points.title: Loading bay throughput（DOCK）
information_points.content:
OPMG-DOCK-PGD：Regarding loading bay throughput for the Mittelland Sub-Basement Depository Plan, the site logistics schematic confirms 3 simultaneous loading bays capable of concurrent heavy-vehicle operations.
OPMG-DOCK-8XI：Regarding loading bay throughput for the Jura Cavern Archive Plan, the site logistics schematic confirms 4 simultaneous loading bays capable of concurrent heavy-vehicle operations.
OPMG-DOCK-2NV：Regarding loading bay throughput for the Alpine Redoubt Repository Plan, the site logistics schematic confirms 2 simultaneous loading bays capable of concurrent heavy-vehicle operations.
